text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I was thrown around 
by that incredible power, but even so...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: A magnificent result! Ha ha, ha ha ha...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"No, considering I need to draw out this 
body's full potential, I shouldn't be 
getting carried away, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, a momentary tribute is necessary. You 
can see it, can't you? The peak of the 
divine bird. And――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let your joy explode! Right now, you 
possess the massive vessel capable of 
expressing it.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right... With this 
state-of-the-art body, I could even 
rejoice just like a flesh-and-blood 
being...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it! Do I look joyful 
enough, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching it, the joy is truly palpable. 
Dr. Wright has acquired a body capable of 
expressing everything he desires.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The planned development period is almost 
at an end. Which means the next step is—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it's the final test. The next 
'Upgrade Exam' will be the last one."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Will they execute it, or will it 
be—failure?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But we've made it this far. Just one 
more step, just one more step...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The body is the strongest. If so, all that 
remains... is what's inside.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"It all depends on my mind and my 
software. As long as they are tuned to 
perfection—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The ST-2 will definitely reach the desired 
realm. Everyone, please see this through 
with me to the very end.
